play.help: Food: choose a spot on the desktop. Ball: drag and release. Esc cancels.
work.help: Settles in a favorite spot and quietly keeps you company.
setting.name: Name
name.help: Your pet remembers its name after a restart.
collection.title: My collection · up to 12 looks
collection.name: Name this look
collection.help: Clothes change accessories only. A full look includes the model and plumage. Your pet keeps its name and size.
collection.mix: Choose a look or mix individual pieces below.
collection.compatibility: Only clothes compatible with this model are shown. Your choices return when you switch back to a compatible model.
interaction.help: Move over the head to pet your pet. Click a wing to wave or the belly to tickle. Drag to pick it up.
quiet.help: You can still play manually. Normal behavior returns when quiet hours end.
quiet.invalid: Enter a time in HH:MM format, from 00:00 to 23:59.
quiet.equal: Matching start and end times disable quiet hours.
quiet.time-help: Uses local time. The period can cross midnight.
power.help: Economy: checks a stationary surface up to every 300 ms and a distant cursor every 1.2 s. Checks speed up during movement. Auto uses the system battery status.
personality.calm-help: Rests more, visits its favorite spot and takes leisurely walks.
personality.playful-help: Runs faster, dances more and gives the ball a stronger push.
personality.curious-help: Explores windows, watches your cursor and peeks over edges.
monitor.help: Follows the active monitor after a short delay or stays on your chosen display. Moves to an available display if one disconnects.
favorite.floor: Favorite spot: bottom of the screen
windows.help: Chooses free edges, prepares to jump and lands gently.
follow-cursor.help: Comes closer when your cursor moves along its path.
cursor.help: Watches the cursor and reacts when it approaches. Checks stop during quiet idle time.
sound.help: Only for the Quack action or mouse-wheel interaction.
bubbles.help: Replies to games, food and petting.
fullscreen.help: While playing games, watching videos or presenting.
reduced.help: A calm pose with fewer automatic animations.
window.title: Desktop Pets · your little companion
settings.applying: Applying settings · checking the saved file…
placement.pea: Click to place food · Esc to cancel
placement.ball: Drag and release to throw a ball · Esc to cancel
error.settings-apply: Could not apply settings. Please try again.
error.settings-confirm: Could not confirm the saved settings. Your latest choice is waiting for a retry.
error.memory-directory: Could not create the memory directory
error.memory-recover: Memory is damaged; checking the backup
error.memory-save: Could not save memory; will retry
error.memory-backup: Could not save the memory backup
speech.place-pea: Place some food on the screen
speech.place-ball: Click and drag to throw a ball
favorite.window: Favorite spot: edge of a %1 window; falls back to the bottom of the screen
bar.name: Pet
bar.tooltip:
%1 · %2
Left click: settings and games · Middle click: feed
Right click: %3
hint.no-screen: Check your display selection under Behavior.
hint.locked: Returns after you unlock the screen.
hint.display-off: Returns when the display turns on.
reason.not-ready: Your pet is still getting ready
